textVi.value: Nếu trễ hạn, bạn phải trả lãi trên nợ gốc quá hạn, tối đa 150% lãi suất trong hạn. Tiền lãi chậm trả bị tính thêm lãi, tối đa 10%/năm. Ngoài ra có thể bị phạt 8% số tiền liên quan đến điều khoản bạn vi phạm, nếu bạn vi phạm hợp đồng ở điểm khác ngoài việc trả chậm. Có phí phạt chậm trả nhưng FE Credit không công bố mức phí.

representativeExamples.note: Page example: 10M, 12 months, 1.41%/month ('16,92%/năm' = 1.41 x 12, nominal, NOT an effective APR), 974,000/month, total 11,692,000. Check: flat gives 10,000,000/12 + 141,000 = 974,333/month; 12 x 974,333 = 11,692,000 = the stated total exactly. 12 x the rounded 974,000 = 11,688,000, a 4,000 VND rounding difference, so the numbers are consistent under flat interest. Annuity at 1.41%/month would be about 911,600/month, which does not match. Basis and amortization are therefore inferred. T&C 4.2/4.5 conflict (see conflicts). Insurance inclusion not stated.

researchNotes: 1) Licensing: FE Credit is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id fe-credit, licence 69/GP-NHNN). The legal name matches the list. 2) No loan fee schedule (biểu phí) or rate table is published for cash/installment loans; only credit cards have per-card biểu phí pages (not read). Early-repayment fee (T&C 6.2.4, on remaining principal) and late-payment fee have no published rate or amount. A 12.000 VND collection service fee per instalment appears in T&C 5.3.3 (not on product pages). 3) Rate basis conflict: motorbike/phone FAQs say interest is on dư nợ ban đầu and fixed (flat), but T&C 4.2/4.5 (effective 14/08/2026) say interest accrues daily on actual outstanding principal (365-day year) and the converted rate is for reference only. Flat stored (costlier) for all three loans. The cash-loan page never states the basis; its worked example (10M, 12 months, 1.41%/month, 974,000/month, 11,692,000 total) fits flat arithmetic only, so flat is inferred there. The 16,92%/năm in that example is 1.41 x 12, nominal, not an APR. 4) Other conflicts stored conservatively: cash-loan term 6-36 (FAQ) vs 3-60 (calculator): 6-36 stored; phone loan rate FAQ 0-2.69 vs calculator 1.41-3.86: 1.41-3.86 stored; motorbike FAQ 0-5.7 vs calculator 1.41-3.86: 1.41-5.7 stored; phone max amount FAQ 100M vs calculator slider 20M: 20M stored. 5) Calculator shows 19.000.000 VND monthly next to 6.129 VND/ngày (page bug, ignored). 6) Insurance is optional, premium ratio unpublished. Product pages say the premium is paid at the disbursement step to the agent VPB SMBC FC; T&C 1.4 and 2.4 allow a loan to finance it, so the collection method is recorded as unknown with a conflict. 7) Other products not captured: FE Paylater (Mua trước trả sau, 0% up to 45 days; fee PDF not read), B@W. 8) The '$NAP' app name is not verified as FE Credit's and is not recorded. FE ONLINE is the app named on official pages. 9) Only the first 100,000 of about 280,000 characters of each product page were re-read on 2026-11-02. Third-party articles gave different rates (e.g. 2.17-2.83%/month) and were not used. 10) Late penalty figures (150% ceiling, 10%/year ceiling, 8% breach penalty) were not compared against Circular 39 art. 13(4); a lawyer should check.
